:::{#def-cosine-decay}
#### Cosine decay

Let $\schedlen$ be a number of updates, <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
and let $\iterpoint{\steplen}{0} > 0$ be the [step length](#def-gradient-descent) before update $1$.
The **cosine decay** schedule [@loshchilov2017sgdr] is

$$
\iterpoint{\steplen}{t} \eqdef \frac{\iterpoint{\steplen}{0}}{2}\paren{1 + \cos\frac{\pi t}{\schedlen}},
\qquad
t = 0, 1, \ldots, \schedlen.
$$

:::
